title: Pure Spirit monster
summary: The Spirit Monster archetype revolves around monsters that cannot be Special Summoned and return to the owner's hand during the End Phase of the turn they are Normal Summoned—led by the Rank 4 Spirit engine (Aratama, Sakitama, and Nikitama), the floodgate bosses Amano-Iwato and Yata-Garasu, and the Shinobird Ritual Spirits (Shinobaron Peacock and Shinobaroness Peacock)! Normal Summon Aratama to search Sakitama, then reveal Sakitama in your hand to immediately Normal Summon it as an extra Spirit Normal Summon! Overlay them into Rank 4s or Tribute them with Shinobird's Calling / Stars Align across the Milky Way (which Ritual Summons Shinobaron Peacock from your Deck on the opponent's turn to bounce up to 3 of their monsters without targeting and cheat out Amano-Iwato to lock out all non-Spirit monster effects!).

allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Normal Spell that adds BOTH 'Shinobird's Calling' AND either 'Shinobaron Peacock' or 'Shinobaroness Peacock' from your Deck or GY to your hand!
allow.Bujintei Tsukuyomi: Rank 4 LIGHT Beast-Warrior Xyz (2 Level 4 LIGHT monsters: Sakitama + Nikitama) that detaches 1 material (triggering Nikitama's draw effect!) to discard your remaining hand and draw 2 fresh cards.
allow.Daigusto Emeral: Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 4 Xyz that detaches 1 material to shuffle 3 Spirit/Ritual monsters from your GY into the Deck and draw 1 card.
allow.Tornado Dragon: Rank 4 WIND Wyrm Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters: Aratama + Sakitama) that detaches 1 material as a Quick Effect to destroy a Spell/Trap (triggering Shinobird Power Spot's search when a WIND monster leaves or via Spirit returns!).
allow.Time Thief Redoer: Rank 4 Xyz made with any two Level 4 Spirits (Aratama, Sakitama, Nikitama) that banishes itself until the End Phase.
allow.Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder: Rank 12 Xyz stacked over a Rank 4 Xyz after battle.

main: Sakitama

Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Spirit: reveals itself in your hand to immediately Normal Summon 1 Spirit monster from your hand (without using your regular Normal Summon!); if Tributed (such as for a Shinobird Ritual Summon!), mandatory trigger to target 1 Spirit monster in your GY and add it back to your hand!
Aratama
Core Level 4 DARK Fiend Spirit: when Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, adds ANY Spirit monster (Sakitama, Nikitama, Amano-Iwato, Yata-Garasu, or Shinobaron Peacock!) from your Deck to your hand!
Nikitama

Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Spirit: during your Main Phase, if you control a Spirit monster, you can Normal Summon 1 Spirit monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set; and if sent to the GY while you control a Spirit monster (including when detached from a Rank 4 Xyz while another Spirit is on field!), you immediately draw 1 card!
Amano-Iwato

Signature Level 4 EARTH Rock Spirit floodgate (1900 ATK): while face-up on the field, monsters CANNOT activate their effects, except Spirit monsters—and if Special Summoned from your hand or Deck by Shinobaron/Shinobaroness Peacock, it bypasses its own Spirit return condition (or returns to be Normal Summoned again next turn)!
Yata-Garasu

Iconic Level 2 WIND Fiend Spirit (Unlimited in TCG!): when this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent, skips the Draw Phase of their next turn—locking your opponent out of drawing new cards after Shinobaron Peacock clears their board!
Konohanasakuya

Level 3 EARTH Fairy Spirit: Special Summons itself from your hand if you control a Spirit monster, and banishes itself from your GY during the End Phase to negate the effects of 1 Spirit monster you control (preventing Shinobaron Peacock or Amano-Iwato from returning to the hand/Deck!).
Shinobaron Peacock

Signature Level 8 WIND Winged Beast Ritual Spirit boss (3000 ATK; searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites and Aratama!): when Ritual Summoned, returns up to 3 monsters your opponent controls to the hand WITHOUT targeting, then can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Spirit monster (Amano-Iwato!) from your hand, ignoring its summoning conditions; spawns 2 WIND Tokens when returning to the hand in the End Phase!
Shinobaroness Peacock

Signature Level 8 WIND Winged Beast Ritual Spirit boss (2500 ATK; searchable by Pre-Preparation of Rites!): when Ritual Summoned, shuffles up to 3 Spells/Traps your opponent controls into the Deck WITHOUT targeting, then can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Spirit monster (Amano-Iwato!) directly from your DECK, ignoring its summoning conditions!
Shinobaron Shade Peacock

Level 4 WIND Winged Beast Ritual Spirit (Duelist Nexus): tributes itself after being Ritual Summoned to add 1 Spirit monster AND 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand, and Special Summons itself back during your next Standby Phase when banished for a Ritual Summon!
Shinobaroness Shade Peacock

Level 4 WIND Winged Beast Ritual Spirit (Duelist Nexus): when Ritual Summoned, adds any Spell/Trap that mentions 'Spirit monster' (Stars Align across the Milky Way or Shinobird Power Spot!) from your Deck to your hand!
Shinobird's Calling

Core Ritual Spell: Ritual Summons any 'Shinobird' Ritual Monster from your hand by Tributing monsters from your hand/field OR banishing Spirit monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level!
Shinobird Power Spot

Continuous Spell (searched by Shinobaroness Shade Peacock!): boosts all Spirit monsters by 500 ATK/DEF, and once per turn when a face-up WIND monster(s) you control returns to your hand, adds ANY Spirit monster or Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand!
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Adds both Shinobird's Calling and either Shinobaron Peacock or Shinobaroness Peacock from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Stars Align across the Milky Way

Signature Normal Trap (searchable by Shinobaroness Shade Peacock!): reveals a Ritual Monster in your hand to add a Ritual Monster with the same Level and a different name from your Deck to your hand; and banishes itself from your GY during your opponent's Main Phase to send 1 Ritual Spell from your hand to the GY and copy its Ritual Summon effect (Ritual Summoning Shinobaron Peacock on the opponent's turn!)!
extra: Rank 4 LIGHT Xyz (Sakitama + Nikitama) that detaches Nikitama to draw 1 card from Nikitama and 2 cards from Tsukuyomi.
Limited to 1 in TCG: Rank 4 Xyz that recycles 3 Spirits/Rituals from your GY to draw 1 card.
Rank 4 WIND Xyz (Aratama + Sakitama) that destroys opposing Spells/Traps as a Quick Effect.
Rank 4 Xyz that dodges board wipes and detaches Spirit materials.
Rank 12 Xyz stacked over a Rank 4 Xyz after battle.
